svg.text: Secure evidence and document platform for the criminal justice system
SIH 2026 - PS 26190 - MHA / NCRB Women Safety Division
ZERO-TRUST GUARD - SINGLE CHOKE POINT FOR EVERY REQUEST
No implicit access. No "admin sees everything". No role that can read a sealed document alone.
Sealing happens BEFORE storage: hash, encrypt, sign, anchor - in that order.
Compromise of one key exposes exactly one document.
INTEGRATION BUS - INTERFACES DEFINED, NOT YET WIRED
Six contracts. Hashes, codes and counters only.
VALIDATOR SET - INSTITUTIONS THAT DO NOT REPORT TO ONE ANOTHER
QBFT, 4-of-5 quorum. None can rewrite history alone.
x document content, in any form
x anything content is inferable from
A guard rejects any such payload
and throws. It is not overridable.
16,000 stations x millions of events a day cannot each be a transaction.
Documents anchor individually. Audit events are Merkle-batched: one root
per station per window, every event keeps a short inclusion proof.
